Chart.description: A bar, line, area, pie or scatter chart drawn from rows of data.

x.description: Field name used for the x axis or pie slices.

y.description: Numeric field used for the y axis or slice size.

series.description: Optional field that splits rows into colored series.

of.description: Each row is an object with the x, y and series fields.

on_select.description: Fires when the user taps a bar, point or slice. The selected row goes in the values.

Dashboard.description: A grid of charts and stats.
